info.title: About Visualizations
info.description: Each visualization provides unique insights into lncRNA regulatory networks:
info.network: Explore complex regulatory relationships with interactive node-edge graphs. Filter by species, diseases, and binding affinity.
info.sankey: Visualize three-layer flow from lncRNAs through genes to diseases. Understand regulatory cascades.
info.conservation: Compare conservation patterns across 4 primate species with interactive heatmaps. Click cells to explore shared regulations.
info.genome: View genomic coordinates, ChIP-seq peaks, and RepeatMasker annotations on an IGV.js browser.

sankey.description: Visualize three-layer regulatory relationships: lncRNA → Gene → Disease. Explore how lncRNAs regulate genes associated with diseases.
